what: Claude Code: each person's chat goes on in one conversation (--resume) across events instead of a fresh run per event (task events stay fresh); a new conversation after its size (tokens of the stream), number of runs, a long pause, a new day, a model change or Reset now; before the change the agent writes a short summary (own short run) that comes fenced as context only before the first order of the new one; a conversation that is gone starts fresh once; a notice in the chat at the change; KALMIDO_SESSION_RESUME=0 switches it off
